messages.subject: runMI for lavaan::sem: Subscript out of bounds
parts:
Dear experts,

I hope that you can help me with an error-report when I run runMI. I post here because I noticed another user a year ago reported something similar (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/lavaan/j1mfUaofxRQ/B_Z4_W5tarAJ).

This command: runMI(cid.sem.only, data = mice.imp, fun = "sem", estimator = "WLSMV")
generates this error: Error in `[<-`(`*tmp*`, rhs, lhs, value = 1) : subscript out of bounds

The relevant part of the script looks like this:

------------------------ SCRIPT BEGINS ------------------------
library(mice)
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)

# Create dataset for analysis on imputed data
mice.imp <- NULL
m=5
for(i in 1:m){
mice.imp[[i]] <- complete(data.imp,action=i,include=FALSE)
}


## SEM Model
cid.sem.only<-'
    citA =~ cit1 + cit4
    cceA =~ cce1 + cce4
    ciaA =~ cia2 + cia3
    oitA =~ oit1 + oit2 + oit3 + oit4
    oceA =~ oce1 + oce2 + oce3 + oce4
    oiaA =~ oia1 + oia2 + oia3 + oia4
    witA =~ wit1 + wit2 + wit3 + wit4
    wceA =~ wce1 + wce2 + wce3 + wce4
    wiaA =~ wia1 + wia2 + wia3 + wia4

    cid =~ citA + cceA + ciaA
    oid =~ oitA + oceA + oiaA
    wid =~ witA + wceA + wiaA

    cid ~ oid + wid
    oid ~ wid
'
cid.only.fit<- runMI(cid.sem.only, data = mice.imp, fun = "sem", estimator = "WLSMV")

------------------------ SCRIPT ENDS ------------------------

The multiply imputed dataset has been created with the MICE-package. Analysis for the complete datasets (m = 5) works fine.
I tried following the instructions from the link to the post similar to this one but either it does not work or I am doing something wrong (which is most likely).

Could I kindly ask for your help with getting the above model to work?

If I left something out or you need additional information please let me know and I will provide it.


Best regards,
Mikkel G. Hangaard

PhD. student at
Department for Language and Communication
University of Southern Denmark
